paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 57a, raising an objection to Rav Ashi.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Davidson Eruvin57a has Rav Chanilai Mechozna’ah (מחוזנאה) addressing Rav Ashi with an objection. Preserve supplied מחוזנאי as the single gentilic Mechozna’i, rather than splitting it into an invented Chuzna’i place. The prior Mechoza explanation is a gentilic interpretation, not a new authority/place binding.
